title: OutboxEvent
description: HAR-117 (WP19), HAR-136: a fact core publishes for surfaces (Slack, web) so they react instead of polling the read model. Written in the same transaction as the fact it announces (a trigger on strategy_sets and one on business_intelligence_updates), so an event exists if and only if the fact was committed. Delivery is at-least-once per consumer: a consumer lists its unacknowledged events, acts, then acknowledges; a crash between acting and acknowledging delivers the event again, so consumers must be idempotent. Exactly-once on a surface is the surface's job, through the create-only message refs (surface_message.v1.json).

id.description: Unique and allocated in increasing order when the row is inserted, which is not the order the transactions commit in: a transaction that took a lower id can commit after one that took a higher id. Listing is oldest id first among the committed events; the id is an identity, never a cursor to resume after.

oneOf.description: strategy_set.published: the run's StrategySet and all its EvalBundles are readable at GET /runs/{agent_run_id}/strategies; Slack Message 2 is posted on it. bi_update_id is the update (Message 1) of the episode's AccountChange, null when the episode has none; Message 2 is never posted before that update's Message 1.
bi_update.published: the BusinessIntelligenceUpdate is readable at GET /accounts/{account_id}/business-intelligence/latest while it is the account's latest; Slack Message 1 is posted on it.
